name: Material Icon Theme
about: Material Icon Theme is a free, open-source icon set with 1,176 icons designed by Material Extensions. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Material Icon Theme free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,176 Material Icon Theme are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Material Icon Theme in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Material Icon Theme are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,176 icons in the Material Icon Theme set, designed by Material Extensions. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Material Icon Theme?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Material Icon Theme available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
